title: Bitcoin whale Owen Gunden dumps entire $1.3B stack as institutions tighten grip
summary: Bitcoin OG Owen Gunden sells $1.3 billion in BTC as retail panic grows, while institutional ownership of Bitcoin ETFs climbs to 40% despite market fear.

title: US Bitcoin ETFs snap five-day bloodbath as BTC reclaims $92K

title: Samourai sentences cement DOJ’s money transmitter theory for crypto mixers

summary: BitMine’s $3.7 billion paper loss and the falling mNAV valuations are threatening the business model of DATs, according to 10x Research.

title: Singapore’s ‘finance-savvy’ crypto retail prefers trust over low fees: Survey
summary: Survey data points to cautious allocations, long-term holding and a preference for regulated platforms as Singapore’s retail market continues to mature.

title: Bitcoin Core wins rare praise as independent audit finds no serious flaws
summary: Bitcoin Core’s first independent audit found no serious vulnerabilities, with reviewers praising the project’s security, testing depth and overall code maturity.

title: Bitcoin hits ‘most bearish’ levels: Is the bull cycle ending?

title: Cathie Wood’s ARK loads up on Circle, BitMine, Bullish as crypto stocks slide
